title: Beyond the Keyword: A Human-Annotated Benchmark for Arabic Anxiety-Related Discourse
abstract: arXiv:2611.07949v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Keyword retrieval returns expressions of personal anxiety together with many other uses of anxiety-related language. We present a benchmark of 1,000 Arabic Twitter/X posts retrieved with the keyword qalaq ("anxiety/worry") and annotated for six discourse functions. Two native Arabic-speaking annotators labeled every post independently, reaching 51.1% raw agreement (Cohen's $\kappa = 0.378$). We then reviewed all 489 disagreements and all 511 agreements under the same guidelines. The review changed 120 of the agreed labels (23.5%), which shows that agreements need auditing as well as disagreements. The final labels form a consensus reference; on a random sample of 200 posts, an additional annotator agreed with it on 60.5% of posts ($\kappa = 0.517$). translated_title: 超越关键词：一个阿拉伯语焦虑相关话语的人工标注基准数据集
translated_abstract: 关键词检索在返回个人焦虑表达的同时，也会返回许多其他使用焦虑相关语言的文本。我们提出了一个包含1,000条阿拉伯语Twitter/X帖子的基准数据集，这些帖子通过关键词“qalaq”（焦虑/担忧）检索获得，并按照六种话语功能进行了标注。两名以阿拉伯语为母语的标注者独立标注了每条帖子，原始一致率为51.1%（Cohen's κ = 0.378）。随后，我们在相同的指导原则下审查了全部489处分歧标注和全部511处一致标注。此次审查修改了120条原本一致的标注（23.5%），这表明一致的标注同样需要审计，而不仅仅是分歧部分。最终标签构成了一个共识参考标准；在200条帖子的随机样本上，另一名标注者与该共识参考的一致率为60.5%（κ = 0.517）。以该参考为基准，Fanar-C-2-27B达到了79.8%的准确率和0.784的宏平均F1（κ = 0.749）。其错误集中在剩余类别中（占错误的41.1%；精确率0.905，召回率0……原文在此处截断）
tldr: 本文构建了一个包含1000条阿拉伯语“qalaq”（焦虑）帖子、按六种话语功能人工标注的基准数据集，并发现标注一致的部分同样需要审查（23.5%的一致标签在审查后被修改），最终以共识参考标准评估了Fanar-C-2-27B模型在该任务上的性能。
en_tdlr: This paper presents a human-annotated benchmark of 1,000 Arabic "qalaq" (anxiety) posts labeled with six discourse functions, demonstrating that agreed-upon labels also require auditing (23.5% of agreed labels were revised during review), and uses the resulting consensus reference to evaluate the Fanar-C-2-27B model's performance on this task.
